'''December 2001 Livingston tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Livingston, NJ on 22 December 2001. [[Thomas Hermley-Keen]] won it. It is known from Kelly Krieble's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3207">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-23-livingston-nj-12-22-01d3207/ livingston-nj-12-22-01], DeckTech (Kelly "dr_divot" Krieble, 23 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-23-livingston-nj-12-22-01d3207/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Livingston, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Thomas Hermley-Keen]]
